about_the_game:
There is a church at the end of your street- but there shouldn't be. You saw it when walking home from the bus stop after work. You grew up on this street. You have walked down this road daily.

There is not a church at the end of the street.

In this text-based horror game, you play as someone haunted by a church. It infects your day, and will do anything to get you to come inside. Will you be able to resist it? Or will the church swallow you whole?

Features:

  • Hand Drawn Art

  • The Church 

  • Branching Narrative -  Your choices change how you interact with the church

  • Multiple Endings - Some good, some bad, some ????

content_descriptors.notes:
- Mild gore / dead body descriptions
- General Christan/Catholic discomfort
- General violence towards player/blood/bodily fluids mention. All through text
- Potential child harm/child in distress where player is unable to help
- Some demeaning speech yelled at the player from a male character
